claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament runs from April 6–12 at Augusta National Golf Club.
Competitive rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament run from April 9–12.
The Par 3 Contest is on April 8 at noon ET on ESPN/ESPN+.
Tournament rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament air on ESPN on Thursday and Friday.
Tournament rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament air on CBS on Saturday and Sunday.
Featured holes and groups of the 2026 Masters Tournament stream on Masters.com.
Featured holes and groups of the 2026 Masters Tournament stream on Paramount+.
Practice Rounds of the 2026 Masters Tournament are on Monday to Wednesday April 6-8.
Par 3 Contest of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Wednesday at noon ET on ESPN.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
TV coverage of Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Featured Groups of Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 9:15 a.m. ET on ESPN+.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
TV coverage of Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Featured Groups of Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 9:15 a.m. ET on ESPN+.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
TV coverage of Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 3–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Featured Groups of Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 10:15 a.m. ET on ESPN+.
The final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Featured Groups of the final round of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 10:15 a.m. ET on ESPN+.
Masters Live is available on Masters.com.
Masters Live is available on the Masters App.
Masters Live provides Amen Corner coverage (holes 11, 12, 13).
Masters Live provides featured hole coverage.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament is split between ESPN and CBS.
Streaming options for the 2026 Masters Tournament are on Paramount+ and ESPN+.
